text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-zaaaan!! I, I...
I made my debut, waaah~~!!

"The excitement here is almost as if
someone just conquered the Nippon Derby...!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
*sniff*... This means the Twinkle Series
is finally starting, right?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Uwooh...! Just thinking about it
makes something deep inside me tremble...!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah...! Yeah, yeah,
yeah yeah yeah yeah!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOO!!!
Let's do our best togethheeer!!!

The richly emotional girl's cries echoed through the
underground walkway, refusing to cease for quite some time...!

—At any rate,
a new chapter of challenging days begins!
I psyched myself up once again.
